Services and contracting

Dorset Division provides business strategy, commercial research and practical digital services, including ecommerce, websites, branding, marketing, publishing and project support. Projects are quoted individually and agreed in English. The written scope and quote set out deliverables, price, timescales and any continuing obligations before work begins. Remote international work is available by arrangement.

Prices and tax

Dorset Division is operated by Marnie Danson as a sole trader and is not registered for VAT. No VAT is charged. Starting prices are in pounds sterling unless stated otherwise and apply to defined scopes of work. Your written quote confirms the total payable and any approved third-party costs before you accept. Third-party providers set their own prices and tax treatment.

Intellectual property and links

Dorset Division’s original website content and branding are protected by applicable intellectual property law. Client work and third-party images, names, software and marks remain subject to their owners’ rights and relevant licences. Their appearance does not imply an unclaimed affiliation or endorsement. External links are provided for reference; outside sites control their own content and availability.
